scenes.text: Rainwater is a gift. But most of it flows away, unused.
scenes.heading: Every drop counts.

scenes.text: Rainwater harvesting collects and stores this water for the days we need it most.
scenes.heading: Catch the rain.

scenes.text: From rooftops to storage tanks, a simple system makes every drop count.
scenes.heading: Save it for later.

scenes.text: The result? Greener farms, healthier communities, and a more sustainable tomorrow.
scenes.heading: A greener tomorrow.
